function.description: Provides information such as API version, mandatory core packages for installation or upgrade, optional packages, Cisco Catalyst Center name and version, supported direct updates, and tenant ID.
function.name: api_ciscoCatalystCenterReleaseSummary

corePackages.description: The set of packages that are mandatory to be installed/upgraded with the release

installedVersion.description: The installed Cisco Catalyst Center version

packages.description: The set of packages upgrades available with this release that will not be upgraded unless selected for upgrade

supportedDirectUpdates.description: The list of earlier releases that can upgrade directly to the current release. If the supportedDirectUpdates value is empty, then no direct upgrades to the current release are allowed.

tenantId.description: Tenant ID (for multi tenant Cisco Catalyst Center)

version.description: The MAGLEV-API version (this field is for internal development purpose)
